resources.string: SVP is off. Available in Maximum performance, or in Auto on devices that are not low-end; your saved choice is retained.
Adds in-between frames for smoother motion. MPV (Vulkan or OpenGL output) and VLC only, progressive 8-bit SDR only.
Off hides SVP in the player; On still needs SVP turned on in the panel. Requires Maximum performance, or Auto on a device that is not low-end.
